Class PhaseReporter

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.pyronaut.config.terminal.PhaseReporter
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class PhaseReporter extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Reports a tool's work as a sequence of phases.

On a terminal every running phase is a spinner row carrying an optional detail and its elapsed time; a finished phase collapses into a permanent [elapsed] ✓ message (took) line. Without a terminal the reporter prints deterministic plain lines and never emits control sequences.

Standard output and error are routed through the live region while the reporter is open, so output from libraries and child processes lands above the running rows instead of tearing them.
